s0201.literal: On dingchou day Hesan, grand councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Ministry of Revenue, was made left chancellor and branch secretariat grand councillor; Bodu, associate administrator of the central secretariat, was made grand councillor and branch secretariat right vice chancellor; Hudubuding, deliberator on central secretariat affairs, was made right vice chancellor and branch secretariat left vice chancellor; and Tielituohuan and Jia Jun, deliberators on central secretariat affairs, were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat.
s0201.idiomatic: On dingchou day Hesan, grand councillor of the Liaoyang Branch Ministry of Revenue, was made left chancellor and branch secretariat grand councillor; Bodu, associate administrator of the central secretariat, was made grand councillor and branch secretariat right vice chancellor; Hudubuding, deliberator on central secretariat affairs, was made right vice chancellor and branch secretariat left vice chancellor; and Tielituohuan and Jia Jun, deliberators on central secretariat affairs, were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat.

s0202.literal: On wuyin day censorate officials said: "The ever-normal granary was originally to benefit the people; yet when harvests fail, suddenly establishing it will surely harm the people instead; abolishing it would be expedient.
s0202.idiomatic: On wuyin day censorate officials said, "The ever-normal granary was originally to benefit the people; yet when harvests fail, suddenly establishing it will surely harm the people instead; abolishing it would be expedient.

s0203.literal: " They also said: "The Zhi-da silver notes have only just been issued; the categories are numerous and fragmented, and the people still do not understand; moreover, copper cash is being circulated concurrently — there is concern they may interfere with each other.
s0203.idiomatic: " They also said, "The Zhi-da silver notes have only just been issued; the categories are numerous and fragmented, and the people still do not understand; moreover, copper cash is being circulated concurrently — there is concern they may interfere with each other.

s0204.literal: " They also said: "The seizure of bronze vessels among the people has been extremely urgent and inconvenient; we request detailed deliberation with provincial officials.
s0204.idiomatic: " They also said, "The seizure of bronze vessels among the people has been extremely urgent and inconvenient; we request detailed deliberation with provincial officials.

s0205.literal: " They also said: "In years of famine and food shortage, it is inappropriate suddenly to relax the wine prohibition.
s0205.idiomatic: " They also said, "In years of famine and food shortage, it is inappropriate suddenly to relax the wine prohibition.

s0206.literal: " An order stated: "Have them deliberate with provincial officials."
s0206.idiomatic: An order stated, "Have them deliberate with provincial officials."

s0207.literal: Eleventh month, gengchen new moon: because Xu and Pei had suffered major floods for successive years and the people were displaced, all corvée and tax for the current year was remitted.
s0207.idiomatic: Eleventh month, gengchen new moon: because Xu and Pei had suffered major floods for successive years and the people were displaced, all corvée and tax for the current year was remitted.

s0208.literal: One additional director, vice director, and clerk in the Ministry of Personnel were added, ordering the merit-review office to conduct promotions and dismissals.
s0208.idiomatic: One additional director, vice director, and clerk in the Ministry of Personnel were added, ordering the merit-review office to conduct promotions and dismissals.

s0209.literal: Dongping and Jining both reported famine; half their people's corvée and tax was remitted, and lower households were all exempted.
s0209.idiomatic: Dongping and Jining both reported famine; half their people's corvée and tax was remitted, and lower households were all exempted.

s0210.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "In recent years palace guards have been greatly excessive; most are idle ruffians; those requesting to serve as guards must be granted audience before approval.
s0210.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "In recent years palace guards have been greatly excessive; most are idle ruffians; those requesting to serve as guards must be granted audience before approval.

s0212.literal: Yunnan Province said: "The Eight Hundred Wives, Greater Chelì, and Lesser Chelì rebelled; Gubao of Weiyuan Prefecture seized and occupied Muluodian; an edict dispatched this province's right vice censor Sanzhierwei to go win them over; also ordering one thousand five hundred troops of the Weichu Circuit army to escort him into the territory.
s0212.idiomatic: Yunnan Province said, "The Eight Hundred Wives, Greater Chelì, and Lesser Chelì rebelled; Gubao of Weiyuan Prefecture seized and occupied Muluodian; an edict dispatched this province's right vice censor Sanzhierwei to go win them over; also ordering 1,500 troops of the Weichu Circuit army to escort him into the territory.

s0213.literal: But Sanzhierwei accepted bribes from Gubao of three ingots each of gold and silver, then again advanced troops to attack and plunder; Gubao's archers fired in disorder, and he returned in defeat.
s0213.idiomatic: But Sanzhierwei accepted bribes from Gubao of three ingots each of gold and silver, then again advanced troops to attack and plunder; Gubao's archers fired in disorder, and he returned in defeat.

s0214.literal: Not only was the mission defeated — our men were harmed instead; we beg Your Majesty to judge.
s0214.idiomatic: Not only was the mission defeated — our men were harmed instead; we beg Your Majesty to judge.

s0215.literal: " The Emperor said: "This is a major matter; swiftly select an envoy and again carry imperial sealed letters to win them over; though Sanzhierwei enjoys an amnesty, he may be rigorously interrogated.
s0215.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is a major matter; swiftly select an envoy and again carry imperial sealed letters to win them over; though Sanzhierwei enjoys an amnesty, he may be rigorously interrogated.

s0216.literal: " On jiashen day Prince Su of Ning was granted a gold seal; the crown prince household directorate was raised to second sub-rank.
s0216.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince Su of Ning was granted a gold seal; the crown prince household directorate was raised to second sub-rank.

s0217.literal: On yiyou day the Ministry of Revenue and the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites said: "Suburban sacrifice is the state's greatest rite.
s0217.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Ministry of Revenue and the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites said, "Suburban sacrifice is the state's greatest rite.

s0218.literal: The southern suburban rite has been performed but is not yet complete; the northern suburban rite has not yet been conducted; at this year's winter solstice Heaven will be sacrificed to at the southern suburb — we request Taizu Emperor as associate;
s0218.idiomatic: The southern suburban rite has been performed but is not yet complete; the northern suburban rite has not yet been conducted; at this year's winter solstice Heaven will be sacrificed to at the southern suburb — we request Taizu Emperor as associate;

s0219.literal: At next year's summer solstice Earth will be sacrificed to at the northern suburb — we request Shizu Emperor as associate.
s0219.idiomatic: At next year's summer solstice Earth will be sacrificed to at the northern suburb — we request Shizu Emperor as associate.

s0221.literal: On dinghai day Sanshudai, left vice censor of Huguang Province, was made grand councillor and deliberator on privy council affairs.
s0221.idiomatic: On dinghai day Sanshudai, left vice censor of Huguang Province, was made grand councillor and deliberator on privy council affairs.

s0222.literal: On dingyou day Toghto, Grand Captain and right chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue, supervised compilation of the national history.
s0222.idiomatic: On dingyou day Toghto, grand captain and right chancellor of the Ministry of Revenue, supervised compilation of the national history.

s0223.literal: On jihai day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.
s0223.idiomatic: On jihai day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.

s0224.literal: On gengzi day the moon encroached upon the Senior Minister.
s0224.idiomatic: On gengzi day the moon encroached upon the Senior Minister.

s0225.literal: On xinchou day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "We privately calculate that the state's grain stores cost more each year while receipts fall short.
s0225.idiomatic: On xinchou day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "We privately calculate that the state's grain stores cost more each year while receipts fall short.

s0226.literal: This year Jiangnan's harvest is fairly good; we wish to dispatch envoys for harmonized purchase of grain, but fear rice prices will suddenly soar; we request two thousand ingots of Zhi-da notes be divided among the four provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang — for those who should receive grain next year in various categories, notes at current values may be given, yielding one million; if insufficient, the provinces' funds may be used to make up the difference.
s0226.idiomatic: This year Jiangnan's harvest is fairly good; we wish to dispatch envoys for harmonized purchase of grain, but fear rice prices will suddenly soar; we request 2,000 ingots of Zhi-da notes be divided among the four provinces of Jiang-Zhe, Henan, Jiangxi, and Huguang — for those who should receive grain next year in various categories, notes at current values may be given, yielding 1 million; if insufficient, the provinces' funds may be used to make up the difference.

s0228.literal: On bingwu day Prince Bolunxi killed a man in private enmity and deserved death; Ozharluhuchi, grand preceptor of the imperial clan court, deliberated — Bolunxi being exalted as a clansman of the state, requesting cudgeling; exile to the northern frontier to serve in the army — approved.
s0228.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince Bolunxi killed a man in private enmity and deserved death; Ozharluhuchi, grand preceptor of the imperial clan court, deliberated — Bolunxi being exalted as a clansman of the state, requesting cudgeling; exile to the northern frontier to serve in the army — approved.

s0229.literal: On dingwei day guard officials' sons and younger brothers were selected to fill positions as Directorate of Education students.
s0229.idiomatic: On dingwei day guard officials' sons and younger brothers were selected to fill positions as Directorate of Education students.

s0230.literal: Twelfth month, jimao day: the Emperor personally feasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, presenting posthumous honorifics and temple names for Taizu the Holy Martial Emperor and Empress Guangxian's posthumous honorific; also presenting posthumous honorifics and temple names for Ruizong the Revered and Aid Emperor and Empress Zhuang Sheng's posthumous honorific; each officer was raised one step in provisional rank; the temple's ritual-music households were granted notes and silks in varying amounts.
s0230.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jimao day: the Emperor personally feasted at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, presenting posthumous honorifics and temple names for Taizu the Holy Martial Emperor and Empress Guangxian's posthumous honorific; also presenting posthumous honorifics and temple names for Ruizong the Revered and Aid Emperor and Empress Zhuang Sheng's posthumous honorific; each officer was raised one step in provisional rank; the temple's ritual-music households were granted notes and silks in varying amounts.

s0231.literal: Yuechicha'er, right chancellor of Karakorum Province and grand preceptor, said: "When I served together with Harqasun Darqan, revenue and grain affairs were always deliberated with me.
s0231.idiomatic: Yuechicha'er, right chancellor of Karakorum Province and grand preceptor, said, "When I served together with Harqasun Darqan, revenue and grain affairs were always deliberated with me.

s0232.literal: Since Harqasun died, all receipts and disbursements are no longer reported; grants and seizures are improper; and Right Vice Chancellor Nangjiadai on the contrary treats me with contempt and insult, repeatedly using pretexts to go to the capital.
s0232.idiomatic: Since Harqasun died, all receipts and disbursements are no longer reported; grants and seizures are improper; and right vice chancellor Nangjiadai on the contrary treats me with contempt and insult, repeatedly using pretexts to go to the capital.

s0233.literal: " An order stated: "Shackle Nangjiadai and send him to Karakorum for trial."
s0233.idiomatic: An order stated, "Shackle Nangjiadai and send him to Karakorum for trial."

s0234.literal: A woman of Wuchang surnamed Liu appealed at the censorate that Sanbaonu had seized one jade seal of the fallen Song she had presented, one gold chair, and two night-luminous pearls; by imperial order Ministry of Revenue officials, censor-in-chief Jidefang, Ozharluhuchi Bietiemuer, Palace Domestic Service commissioner Suozhi, and others jointly interrogated.
s0234.idiomatic: A woman of Wuchang surnamed Liu appealed at the censorate that Sanbaonu had seized one jade seal of the fallen Song she had presented, one gold chair, and two night-luminous pearls; by imperial order Ministry of Revenue officials, censor-in-chief Jidefang, Ozharluhuchi Bietiemuer, Palace Domestic Service commissioner Suozhi, and others jointly interrogated.

s0235.literal: Liu said she was the former wife of Commander Zhai; when Sanbaonu was demoted to Wuchang they had dealings; when Sanbaonu rose in rank Liu came to the capital under the pretext of pursuing a fugitive maid; she called on Sanbaonu at his home but received no answer; entering his west corridor she saw on a couch the stolen treasure saddle and hand-stitched brocade kerchief of the fugitive maid; she asked about them but Sanbaonu again gave no answer; leaving in resentment she immediately sought the petition scribe Qiao Yu to draw up a statement; then through Yin Rong she went to see surveillance commission clerk Li Jie and filed the appeal at the censorate.
s0235.idiomatic: Liu said she was the former wife of Commander Zhai; when Sanbaonu was demoted to Wuchang they had dealings; when Sanbaonu rose in rank Liu came to the capital under the pretext of pursuing a fugitive maid; she called on Sanbaonu at his home but received no answer; entering his west corridor she saw on a couch the stolen treasure saddle and hand-stitched brocade kerchief of the fugitive maid; she asked about them but Sanbaonu again gave no answer; leaving in resentment she immediately sought the petition scribe Qiao Yu to draw up a statement; then through Yin Rong she went to see surveillance commission clerk Li Jie and filed the appeal at the censorate.

s0236.literal: The case was concluded — Liu was deemed false.
s0236.idiomatic: The case was concluded — Liu was deemed false.

s0237.literal: By imperial order Qiao Yu was beheaded, Li Jie was bambooed, Liu and Yin Rong were cudgeled and returned to their original registration.
s0237.idiomatic: By imperial order Qiao Yu was beheaded, Li Jie was bambooed, Liu and Yin Rong were cudgeled and returned to their original registration.

s0238.literal: On bingchen day the left and right bureaus of the central secretariat were merged.
s0238.idiomatic: On bingchen day the left and right bureaus of the central secretariat were merged.

s0239.literal: Envoys were dispatched to each circuit to sort out arrears — those due for collection were collected; those due for remission were remitted.
s0239.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to each circuit to sort out arrears — those due for collection were collected; those due for remission were remitted.

s0240.literal: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Shen.
s0240.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon encroached upon Shen.

s0241.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "The salt price per yin should be raised to four liang of Zhi-da silver notes; Guangxi's remains as before; the cost of salt-boiling labor — we request raising it to four qian of Zhi-da silver notes.
s0241.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "The salt price per yin should be raised to four liang of Zhi-da silver notes; Guangxi's remains as before; the cost of salt-boiling labor — we request raising it to four qian of Zhi-da silver notes.

s0243.literal: On xinyou day the prohibition on Han people carrying bows, arrows, and weapons was reiterated.
s0243.idiomatic: On xinyou day the prohibition on Han people carrying bows, arrows, and weapons was reiterated.

s0244.literal: On renxu day Yangqu County suffered earthquake, with sounds like thunder.
s0244.idiomatic: On renxu day Yangqu County suffered earthquake, with sounds like thunder.

s0245.literal: The Western monk Mibuyunzi was enfeoffed as Duke of Ning State and granted a gold seal.
s0245.idiomatic: The Western monk Mibuyunzi was enfeoffed as Duke of Ning State and granted a gold seal.

s0246.literal: On dingchou day an edict declared: "Official salaries are to be increased; grades for posthumous enfeoffment of civil officials are to be fixed.
s0246.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict declared, "Official salaries are to be increased; grades for posthumous enfeoffment of civil officials are to be fixed.

s0247.literal: For those eligible for enfeoffment — envoys who die maintaining integrity in distant service, or who die in battle — add upon their currently conferred provisional rank.
s0247.idiomatic: For those eligible for enfeoffment — envoys who die maintaining integrity in distant service, or who die in battle — add upon their currently conferred provisional rank.

s0248.literal: If rank-six or rank-seven officials die maintaining integrity or in battle, verify the facts and specially confer rank.
s0248.idiomatic: If rank-six or rank-seven officials die maintaining integrity or in battle, verify the facts and specially confer rank.

s0249.literal: For enfeoffment of inner and outer officials of all ranks, those of third rank and above may petition for posthumous epithets.
s0249.idiomatic: For enfeoffment of inner and outer officials of all ranks, those of third rank and above may petition for posthumous epithets.

s0250.literal: For all who petition epithets, permit their families to submit this official's usual meritorious labors, administrative achievements, virtue and conduct, and talents; local offices verify and compare with the family's submission; report through the Ministry of Personnel for review and presentation to the metropolitan secretariat; the metropolitan secretariat approves; the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites verifies deeds and fixes the epithet.
s0250.idiomatic: For all who petition epithets, permit their families to submit this official's usual meritorious labors, administrative achievements, virtue and conduct, and talents; local offices verify and compare with the family's submission; report through the Ministry of Personnel for review and presentation to the metropolitan secretariat; the metropolitan secretariat approves; the Directorate of Sacrificial Rites verifies deeds and fixes the epithet.

s0251.literal: If meritorious kin and great ministers receive epithets by special imperial order, they are not within this rule."
s0251.idiomatic: If meritorious kin and great ministers receive epithets by special imperial order, they are not within this rule."

s0252.literal: Year 3, spring, first month, guiwei day: central secretariat officials were reduced — from guest-reception commissioner downward, one hundred eighty-one posts.
s0252.idiomatic: Year 3, spring, first month, guiwei day: central secretariat officials were reduced — from guest-reception commissioner downward, 181 posts.

s0253.literal: Princes Namuhuli and others were granted twelve thousand ingots of notes; wine merchants under Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner Zhuohunan were granted ten thousand five hundred eighty-eight ingots of notes.
s0253.idiomatic: Princes Namuhuli and others were granted 12,000 ingots of notes; wine merchants under Xuanzheng Bureau commissioner Zhuohunan were granted 10,588 ingots of notes.

s0254.literal: On yiyou day Li Meng was specially appointed Glory-and-Salary Grand Master, grand councillor, Hanlin Academician Exemplar, and associate director of the Palace Domestic Service Bureau.
s0254.idiomatic: On yiyou day Li Meng was specially appointed Glory-and-Salary Grand Master, grand councillor, Hanlin Academician Exemplar, and associate director of the Palace Domestic Service Bureau.

s0255.literal: On dinghai day a white rainbow pierced the sun.
s0255.idiomatic: On dinghai day a white rainbow pierced the sun.

s0256.literal: On wuzi day it was prohibited for inner attendants to increase tax quotas externally or present other items contrary to established regulations.
s0256.idiomatic: On wuzi day it was prohibited for inner attendants to increase tax quotas externally or present other items contrary to established regulations.

s0257.literal: Wutai Monastery was constructed, employing one thousand four hundred artisans and three thousand five hundred soldiers.
s0257.idiomatic: Wutai Monastery was constructed, employing 1,400 artisans and 3,500 soldiers.

s0258.literal: On jichou day Niulin was made deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs.
s0258.idiomatic: On jichou day Niulin was made deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs.

s0259.literal: On gengyin day the Directorate of State Sacrifice was established at upper third grade, in charge of shamans and diviners; the chancellor supervised daily affairs.
s0259.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Directorate of State Sacrifice was established at upper third grade, in charge of shamans and diviners; the chancellor supervised daily affairs.

s0260.literal: On xinmao day Empress Hongjilie was installed; Toghto was dispatched as acting Grand Captain bearing credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.
s0260.idiomatic: On xinmao day Empress Hongjilie was installed; Toghto was dispatched as acting grand captain bearing credentials to confer the jade book and jade seal.

s0261.literal: On renchen day the Palace Domestic Service Bureau was raised to first sub-rank.
s0261.idiomatic: On renchen day the Palace Domestic Service Bureau was raised to first sub-rank.

s0262.literal: On guisi day the Central Auspicious Bureau was established at upper third grade, in charge of the empress's seals.
s0262.idiomatic: On guisi day the Central Auspicious Bureau was established at upper third grade, in charge of the empress's seals.

s0263.literal: On jiawu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.
s0263.idiomatic: On jiawu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.

s0264.literal: On yiwei day the tax-assessment law was fixed; all categories of revenue quotas were calculated from Dade year 11, fixing old quotas and original increases as the standard quota, converted to Zhiyuan note amounts.
s0264.idiomatic: On yiwei day the tax-assessment law was fixed; all categories of revenue quotas were calculated from Dade year 11, fixing old quotas and original increases as the standard quota, converted to Zhiyuan note amounts.

s0265.literal: From Zhi-da year 3 restoration began; beyond that only a ten-percent rate applied — increase of three parts or more counted as lower reward; five parts or more as middle reward; seven parts or more as upper reward; increase of nine parts as highest; less than three parts as lowest.
s0265.idiomatic: From Zhi-da year 3 restoration began; beyond that only a ten-percent rate applied — increase of three parts or more counted as lower reward; five parts or more as middle reward; seven parts or more as upper reward; increase of nine parts as highest; less than three parts as lowest.

s0266.literal: Established quota-rank officials served two-year terms.
s0266.idiomatic: Established quota-rank officials served two-year terms.

s0267.literal: Tax-assessment official grades were fixed: above ten thousand ingots — one chief intendant, one associate intendant, and one vice intendant each;
s0267.idiomatic: Tax-assessment official grades were fixed: above 10,000 ingots — one chief intendant, one associate intendant, and one vice intendant each;

s0268.literal: Above one thousand ingots — two superintendents, two commissioners, and two vice commissioners each;
s0268.idiomatic: Above 1,000 ingots — two superintendents, two commissioners, and two vice commissioners each;

s0269.literal: Above five hundred ingots — one superintendent, one commissioner, and one vice commissioner each;
s0269.idiomatic: Above 500 ingots — one superintendent, one commissioner, and one vice commissioner each;

s0270.literal: Above one hundred ingots — one commissioner and one vice commissioner each.
s0270.idiomatic: Above 100 ingots — one commissioner and one vice commissioner each.

s0271.literal: On bingshen day the Capital Resources Bureau and Currency Directorate were established; dynastic copper cash and Zhi-da cash were ordered to circulate together.
s0271.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Capital Resources Bureau and Currency Directorate were established; dynastic copper cash and Zhi-da cash were ordered to circulate together.

s0272.literal: The Guangping Shunde Route Ironworks Chief Intendant Office was re-established.
s0272.idiomatic: The Guangping Shunde Route Ironworks Chief Intendant Office was re-established.

s0273.literal: On wuxu day an edict ordered Huguang Province to win over the rebel Shangsi Prefecture prefect Huang Shengxu.
s0273.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict ordered Huguang Province to win over the rebel Shangsi Prefecture prefect Huang Shengxu.

s0274.literal: On xinchou day an edict was issued to win over Greater Chelì and Lesser Chelì.
s0274.idiomatic: On xinchou day an edict was issued to win over Greater Chelì and Lesser Chelì.

s0275.literal: Privy Council officials said: "Guai Xidai Man tribesmen Amma and others joined ten thousand men to invade; Ten-Thousand Household Yelü Sinu has already been dispatched leading one thousand troops, and Si and Bo native troops are being mobilized to jointly suppress and capture.
s0275.idiomatic: Privy Council officials said, "Guai Xidai Man tribesmen Amma and others joined 10,000 men to invade; Ten-Thousand Household Yelü Sinu has already been dispatched leading 1,000 troops, and Si and Bo native troops are being mobilized to jointly suppress and capture.

s0276.literal: We deliberated — the urgency of affairs and key points of the terrain Sinu knows thoroughly; we request he be permitted discretionary deployment.
s0276.idiomatic: We deliberated — the urgency of affairs and key points of the terrain Sinu knows thoroughly; we request he be permitted discretionary deployment.

s0278.literal: On renyin day an edict addressed the Eight Hundred Wives; Yunnan Province right vice censor Sanzhierwei was dispatched to win them over.
s0278.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict addressed the Eight Hundred Wives; Yunnan Province right vice censor Sanzhierwei was dispatched to win them over.

s0279.literal: On guimao day the crown prince's junior household tutor was changed to vice household tutor.
s0279.idiomatic: On guimao day the crown prince's junior household tutor was changed to vice household tutor.

s0280.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials were ordered retained at the quota established when Antong headed the secretariat; those already eliminated were reassigned ranks by the Ministry of Revenue.
s0280.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials were ordered retained at the quota established when Antong headed the secretariat; those already eliminated were reassigned ranks by the Ministry of Revenue.

s0281.literal: Privy council posts were reduced — seven privy councillors, two associate privy councillors, two privy council vice marshals, two privy council associate administrators, and one privy council junior associate administrator retained.
s0281.idiomatic: Privy council posts were reduced — seven privy councillors, two associate privy councillors, two privy council vice marshals, two privy council associate administrators, and one privy council junior associate administrator retained.

s0282.literal: Two censorate posts were added; censor-in-chief, censor commissioner, attending censor, and investigating censor — two each.
s0282.idiomatic: Two censorate posts were added; censor-in-chief, censor commissioner, attending censor, and investigating censor — two each.

s0283.literal: Transmission Bureau posts were reduced by six; twelve retained.
s0283.idiomatic: Transmission Bureau posts were reduced by six; 12 retained.

s0284.literal: Guangwukangli guard troops were culled; those not of their breed were returned to original registration; all subordinate to Princes Ajiji, Huolangsa, and the southern tammachi — the privy council was ordered to dispatch men on the spot to fix the registers.
s0284.idiomatic: Guangwukangli guard troops were culled; those not of their breed were returned to original registration; all subordinate to Princes Ajiji, Huolangsa, and the southern tammachi — the privy council was ordered to dispatch men on the spot to fix the registers.

s0285.literal: At last year's court assembly Princes Botiemuer and Alatiemuer were each granted two hundred fifty liang of gold, one thousand liang of silver, and four hundred ingots of notes.
s0285.idiomatic: At last year's court assembly Princes Botiemuer and Alatiemuer were each granted 250 liang of gold, 1,000 liang of silver, and 400 ingots of notes.

s0286.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered privy councillors Dadu and Heleqhesun to resume their posts.
s0286.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered privy councillors Dadu and Heleqhesun to resume their posts.

s0287.literal: On dingwei day the Right Guard Asud Private Army Command was established at upper third grade.
s0287.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Right Guard Asud Private Army Command was established at upper third grade.

s0288.literal: Second month, gengxu day: because the empress received the investiture book, envoys were dispatched to announce thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0288.idiomatic: Second month, gengxu day: because the empress received the investiture book, envoys were dispatched to announce thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0289.literal: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Moon.
s0289.idiomatic: On xinhai day Mars transgressed the Moon.

s0290.literal: The falconry bureau Masuhu was granted one hundred liang of gold and five hundred liang of silver.
s0290.idiomatic: The falconry bureau Masuhu was granted 100 liang of gold and 500 liang of silver.

s0291.literal: On jiwei day the Hui-Tong Canal was dredged; four thousand eight hundred ingots of notes and twenty-one thousand shi of grain were granted to recruit laborers; Henan Province grand councillor Tashihaiya was ordered to supervise the project.
s0291.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Hui-Tong Canal was dredged; 4,800 ingots of notes and 21,000 shi of grain were granted to recruit laborers; Henan Province grand councillor Tashihaiya was ordered to supervise the project.

s0292.literal: Deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs Liu Ji was dispatched to rectify the note system.
s0292.idiomatic: Deliberator on Ministry of Revenue affairs Liu Ji was dispatched to rectify the note system.

s0293.literal: Two Dadu patrol courts were added, each governing one quadrant.
s0293.idiomatic: Two Dadu patrol courts were added, each governing one quadrant.

s0294.literal: On renxu day the moon encroached upon the Left Enforcer.
s0294.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon encroached upon the Left Enforcer.

s0295.literal: On jiazi day, because of the empress dowager's honorific title, announcement sacrifice was performed at the southern suburb.
s0295.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because of the empress dowager's honorific title, announcement sacrifice was performed at the southern suburb.

s0296.literal: On yichou day Jia Jun, associate privy council administrator, was again made associate administrator of the central secretariat.
s0296.idiomatic: On yichou day Jia Jun, associate privy council administrator, was again made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0297.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Official rank grades already have fixed regulations; recently those seeking ranks by supreme edict, empress edict, or princess edict often skip grades; we wish to follow Emperor Shizu's old system and grant them in sequence.
s0297.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Official rank grades already have fixed regulations; recently those seeking ranks by supreme edict, empress edict, or princess edict often skip grades; we wish to follow Emperor Shizu's old system and grant them in sequence.

s0299.literal: On dingmao day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "When Zhiyuan notes were first issued, Zhongtong note reserves supplied expenses and their blocks were destroyed.
s0299.idiomatic: On dingmao day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "When Zhiyuan notes were first issued, Zhongtong note reserves supplied expenses and their blocks were destroyed.

s0300.literal: Now that Zhi-da silver notes are being issued, we request Zhiyuan notes be deposited in the Myriad-Estates Treasury, their blocks destroyed — only Zhi-da notes and copper cash circulating together by equivalent weight would be expedient.
s0300.idiomatic: Now that Zhi-da silver notes are being issued, we request Zhiyuan notes be deposited in the Myriad-Estates Treasury, their blocks destroyed — only Zhi-da notes and copper cash circulating together by equivalent weight would be expedient.
